yourImpact: Title of the impact module and page.
backToHomepage: Back button label on the impact page.
refresh: Icon button that refetches the user’s live impact statistics.
loadingYourImpact: Accessible name of the progress bar while impact statistics load.
loading: Button label while impact statistics load.
loadImpact: Button that fetches the user’s impact statistics for the first time.
viewsTitle: Impact card title. $1 = pre-formatted, usually compact view count (e.g. "628.7K"), so no PLURAL.
viewLabelViews: Caption next to the total view count.
thanksReceived: Stat label: number of thanks the user received.
longestEditingStreak: Stat label: most consecutive days with at least one edit.
longestStreak: Stat label: most consecutive days with at least one edit.
editsReviewed: Stat label: number of other people’s edits the user reviewed.
lastEdited: Stat label; the value is a relative time such as "3 days ago".
aMonthAgo: Sample value of {{msg|impact-lastEdited}} in the demo data.
recentActivityTitle: Heading of the edit activity bar chart. $1 = number of days covered (60).
editsCountLabel: Label under the number of edits in the activity chart.
mostViewedTitle: Heading of the list of the user’s edited articles with the most views.
emptyHeadline: Empty-state heading for a user with no edits.
emptyHeadlineSentence: Empty-state heading for a user with no edits (with final punctuation).
seeAllSuggestions: Button opening the list of suggested edits.
errorMissingUsername: Error when impact is requested without a username.
errorEnterUsername: Error when impact is refreshed without a username.
errorUserNotFound: Error when the account doesn’t exist. $1 = username.
errorFetchFailed: Generic error when impact statistics fail to load.
